title: Full workout · interval integration preview
note: Workout-flow preview with one-card plank and suitcase-carry blocks. Start the first regular exercise in a strength/core section to begin Watch recording; its interval blocks then keep that recording running. This is a testing sequence, not an instruction to add exercise volume today.

items.name: Single lean-back quad stretch
items.instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight. Bend the other knee and place that foot beside your buttock, then slowly lean back with support. Repeat on the other side without forcing the position.

items.name: Butterfly stretch
items.instructions: Sit with the soles of your feet together. Let your knees relax outward and keep your back comfortably upright. Do not force your knees down.

items.name: Plow pose with feet suspended
items.instructions: Use your usual straight-leg variation with feet suspended overhead. Do not force a deeper position or turn your head. Stop if uncomfortable.

items.name: Brisk walk
items.instructions: Conversational effort, no jogging today. Slow down if needed.

items.name: Supported dumbbell rows
items.instructions: Support torso and keep spine neutral.

items.name: Dumbbell bench press
items.instructions: Use a stable flat weight bench with feet supported on the floor. Keep wrists over elbows and elbows comfortably angled from your torso. Lower through a comfortable range, then press smoothly. Start lighter when switching from the floor.

items.name: Bodyweight glute bridges
items.instructions: Controlled movement, avoid back arching and groin strain.

items.name: Suitcase carries
items.detail: 2 rounds · 30 sec per hand · 5 sec switches · 30 sec middle rest
items.instructions: Left 30 sec → switch 5 sec → right 30 sec → rest 30 sec → left 30 sec → switch 5 sec → right 30 sec. Walk upright without leaning and breathe normally. Check the card after completing the entire block.

items.name: Bird dogs
items.instructions: Small range, steady hips, no back arching.

items.name: Dead bugs
items.instructions: Keep knees bent and shorten reach if uncomfortable.

items.name: Forearm plank
items.detail: 2 × 60 sec holds · 60 sec rest between holds
items.instructions: Hold 60 sec → rest 60 sec → hold 60 sec, then finish. Keep breathing and maintain a comfortable, controlled position. Check the card after completing both holds.

items.name: Side planks
items.detail: 2 rounds · 30 sec per side · 5 sec to get ready
items.instructions: Left 30 sec → switch 5 sec → right 30 sec → rest 30 sec → left 30 sec → switch 5 sec → right 30 sec. After the final hold, check this card to confirm the entire block is complete.
